name: protonx-legal-tc
creator: protonx-models
old_description_hint: Seq2Seq Transformer for Vietnamese legal text correction and OCR post-processing. Best at: correcting OCR errors, diacritic restoration, and normalizing legal Vietnamese documents. Domains: legal, Vietnamese language, document processing. Typical uses: OCR output cleanup, government decree normalization, contract proofreading, administrative document processing. Not suited for: non-Vietnamese text or general-domain grammar correction.

name: DNABERT-2-117M
creator: zhihan1996
old_description_hint: Transformer-based genome foundation model trained on multi-species DNA sequences for biological representation learning. Best at: encoding DNA sequences into meaningful embeddings for downstream genomic tasks. Domains: genomics, bioinformatics, molecular biology. Typical uses: DNA sequence classification, genome analysis, embedding generation for genetic research. Not suited for: non-DNA sequences, protein sequences, or non-genomic tasks.

name: ast-finetuned-audioset-10-10-0.4593
creator: MIT
old_description_hint: Audio Spectrogram Transformer by MIT fine-tuned on AudioSet for sound classification. Best at: General-purpose audio event and environmental sound classification. Typical uses: Sound event detection, acoustic environment monitoring, audio indexing and retrieval. Not suited for: Speech-specific tasks, real-time edge inference requirements.

name: wav2vec2-large-robust-24-ft-age-gender
creator: audeering
old_description_hint: Wav2Vec2 large model fine-tuned for speaker age and gender prediction from audio. Best at: Estimating approximate speaker age and gender classification from speech signals. Typical uses: Speaker profiling, demographic analysis, voice authentication, content moderation. Not suited for: Speech transcription, non-speech audio analysis.

name: audiobox-aesthetics
creator: facebook
old_description_hint: Meta's unified automatic quality assessment model for speech, music, and sound. Best at: Evaluating production quality across multiple aesthetic dimensions. Typical uses: Automatic audio QA, content quality filtering, benchmark automation for audio products. Not suited for: Subjective artistic style assessment, genre-specific evaluation.

name: clap-htsat-fused
creator: laion
old_description_hint: LAION's Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining model for audio understanding. Best at: Zero-shot audio classification using natural language descriptions. Typical uses: Sound event detection, audio tagging, text-to-audio retrieval, acoustic scene analysis. Not suited for: Speech transcription, music generation, single-modality tasks.

name: wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese
creator: jonatasgrosman
old_description_hint: Fine-tuned Wav2Vec2 model for Japanese automatic speech recognition by Jonatas Grosman. Best at: Transcribing Japanese speech at 16kHz. Typical uses: Meeting transcription, voice commands, subtitle generation in Japanese. Not suited for: Other languages, audio outside 16kHz specification.

name: wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-portuguese
creator: jonatasgrosman
old_description_hint: Fine-tuned Wav2Vec2 model for Portuguese automatic speech recognition by Jonatas Grosman. Best at: Transcribing Portuguese speech (Brazilian and Portugal variants) at 16kHz. Typical uses: Portuguese meeting transcription, voice notes, subtitle generation. Not suited for: Other languages, audio sampled below 16kHz.

name: whisper-large-v3-turbo
creator: openai
old_description_hint: Pruned Whisper large-v3 by OpenAI with reduced decoder layers for faster inference. Best at: Multilingual speech transcription and speech-to-English translation. Typical uses: Real-time meeting transcription, video captioning, live stream transcription. Not suited for: Maximum accuracy requirements, requires accepting minor quality trade-off for speed.

name: speaker-diarization-3.1
creator: pyannote
old_description_hint: Speaker diarization pipeline from pyannote for identifying and tracking speakers in audio. Best at: determining who speaks and when in conversations. Domains: audio processing, meeting transcription. Typical uses: speaker attribution in transcripts, speech processing, audio analysis. Not suited for: real-time streaming or very noisy audio.

name: speaker-diarization-community-1
creator: pyannote
old_description_hint: Open-source speaker diarization model from pyannote for identifying and tracking speakers in conversations with improved speaker assignment. Best at: determining speaker identity and counting distinct speakers. Domains: audio processing, transcription services. Typical uses: meeting transcription, speaker attribution, audio segmentation. Not suited for: heavily overlapped speech scenarios.

name: dpt-hybrid-midas
creator: Intel
old_description_hint: DPT-Hybrid (MiDaS 3.0) monocular depth estimator by Intel. Vision Transformer backbone trained on 1.4M images (MIX 6 dataset). Best at: zero-shot cross-dataset depth estimation. Typical uses: 3D scene reconstruction, augmented reality, robotics. Not suited for: fine-tuning without substantial data.
